text: In nineteen ninety six, a Pepsi ad offered a Harrier jet. The price: seven million Pepsi Points. Points could be bought for ten cents each. So, about seven hundred thousand dollars. John Leonard sent fifteen points, and a check for the rest. Pepsi sent the check back. A judge ruled no reasonable person would think the offer was serious. Pepsi then changed the ad to seven hundred million points. Just kidding. Would you have tried it?
